what: User direction on config hygiene (2026-04-22): when adding ANY new config setting to aide-memory, always (1) include an inline clarifying comment in `scripts/hooks/defaults.json` or the TypeScript schema explaining what the setting does, its default, and when to change it; (2) add/update the corresponding section in `docs/user/configuration.md` with the same info for end users; (3) update `docs/user/cli-reference.md` valid-keys list + one-line description; (4) ensure `scripts/hooks/__tests__/all-configs-behavior.test.sh` has a case proving the setting actually changes behavior (PASS) or explicitly documents why it can't (SKIP with reason). This is a repeating pattern — configs getting added without docs caused the 4-product-bug situation from memory #304. Checklist applies to BOTH new settings and any setting whose semantics change (e.g. embeddings.backend gaining new accepted values).
why: Locks in the "configs without docs is a user-trust bug" rule discovered when auditing the config surface. Every config addition from this point forward should go through all 4 checklist steps — prevents future dead-config drift.
